label: 예상 게임화면 · AI 생성 시안
stylePrompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: expected gameplay screenshot for a Korean cozy magic-school life RPG design document. Create a complete wide 16:9 TOP-DOWN 2D PIXEL ART gameplay scene, like a polished playable indie life-sim screenshot, NOT a painting, NOT isometric, NOT a concept art poster. Crisp deliberate square pixel clusters, 16px terrain tile logic, 24-32px tall character sprite logic, nearest-neighbor pixel feel, attractive detailed readable props, restrained rich warm colors. Original world, no recognizable copyrighted characters or game assets. Same player in every scene: short silver hair, plum-purple student cloak, tan satchel. Other adult students have varied silhouettes and green/navy/brown cloaks. Show the player performing the activity, clear spatial layout, visible actionable objects. Full-bleed scene with no border, no watermark, NO letters or words, no text boxes; web document will add legible HUD. Keep top 9% and bottom 12% relatively quiet for HUD overlay. Camera stays above the floor with front-facing furniture sides, familiar cozy farming RPG perspective. Landscape wide composition.

screens.title: 등교와 하루 계획
screens.focus: 게시판·건물 입구·이동하는 학생을 한 화면에 보여줘 하루의 선택을 읽게 한다.
screens.scene: CAMPUS DAILY LIFE: morning courtyard with fountain, classroom and greenhouse, student schedules and noticeboard.

screens.title: 수업과 공동 실습
screens.focus: 교수의 시범과 친구의 실습을 보며 같은 원리를 직접 시험한다.
screens.scene: CLASSROOM PRACTICAL LESSON: warm wood magic classroom viewed top down, six separate practice desks, brass weights and hovering books, professor by demonstration chalkboard containing only geometric diagrams no text, purple-cloaked silver-haired player actively levitating a stone weight above a glowing floor practice square, classmates watching and practicing. Show a clearly highlighted target object and blue dotted trajectory.

screens.title: 주문 조합과 환경 퍼즐
screens.goal: 물결로 수위를 높이고 서리로 길을 만드세요
screens.focus: 물의 높이·얼어 있는 구간·목표 지점으로 마법의 결과를 바로 확인한다.
screens.scene: ENVIRONMENTAL SPELL PUZZLE: small ancient academy waterworks puzzle room, stone walkways bordering bright blue channels, two controllable brass valves, a wooden floating platform, some water frozen into translucent pixel ice tiles leading toward a raised exit; player using a blue water spell to fill a basin with a clearly visible water arc, readable cause-effect composition, calm puzzle no enemies.

screens.title: 온실 재배와 생물 돌봄
screens.focus: 작은 화분과 수확 부위 선택이 중심이다. 대형 농장 관리 화면으로 만들지 않는다.
screens.scene: GREENHOUSE GARDENING AND CREATURE CARE: intimate glasshouse interior top down, six personal ceramic pots in foreground and twelve communal small soil beds neatly arranged in middle, colorful tiny magic herbs and flower plants, watering runnels, small safe habitat enclosure with adorable round original magical critters on right; player casting green sprout magic on a single plant, leaf flower and seed growth visible on neighboring pots, adult botanical student nearby.

screens.title: 연금과 요리 실험
screens.goal: 허브와 냉각 성질을 조합해 진정 차를 만드세요
screens.focus: 재료·성질·결과를 비교하며 실험한다. 제작 대기보다 선택과 반응을 보여준다.
screens.scene: ALCHEMY AND COOKING EXPERIMENT: cozy communal kitchen and small alchemy bench in same top down room, bubbling turquoise cauldron and teapot, three clearly separated ingredient dishes of purple herb, blue cooling crystal, golden petals, wooden shelves bottles copper pots, player adding a glowing herb to steaming teapot while companion tastes soup; a tiny safe cooling frost effect beside stove, readable workbench foreground no menus no text.

screens.title: 기숙사 꾸미기와 생활 개선
screens.focus: 배치 격자와 미리보기로 직접 만든 공간임을 보여준다.
screens.scene: DORMITORY DECORATING: charming student bedroom top down with bed bookshelf desk rugs plants and starry lamp, open floor clear square placement grid on part of wooden flooring, silver-haired purple-cloaked player levitating a wooden astronomy desk in a translucent mint placement preview with four pixel corner brackets; cozy window at dusk, satchel and schoolbooks, gold blue star lighting, no text no UI panels.

screens.title: 예고를 읽는 마법 전투
screens.goal: 돌진을 피한 뒤 물결로 인형을 식히세요
screens.focus: 적의 붉은 예고 범위와 냉각 약점이 이펙트 속에서도 보여야 한다.
screens.scene: REAL TIME MAGIC COMBAT: top down stone academy maintenance room, one overheating brass cleaning automaton enemy with glowing orange vents, red rectangular attack telegraph projected on the floor clearly pointing AWAY from player, player sidestepping and casting a bright blue cooling water arc at enemy, two small ink blob enemies spaced away, cover pillar and water barrels, dramatic but readable crisp pixel visual effects not clutter, no gore, no text.

screens.title: 탐험과 선택 조사실
screens.focus: 안전 거점·갈림길·관찰 대상이 보여 다음 행동을 스스로 고르게 한다.
screens.scene: EXPLORATION OPTIONAL ROOM: lush magical woodland top down, clear branching dirt path, vine bridge over narrow ravine, movable stone weights at bridge supports, glowing moss and little butterflies, a safe waypoint lantern at path junction, silver-haired purple player approaching bridge, distant academy roof barely visible, legible walkable areas and tempting side path to specimen plant, no giant boss no words.

screens.title: 친구와 보내는 저녁
screens.focus: 친밀도 숫자보다 함께하는 활동과 표정·소품으로 관계를 전달한다.
screens.scene: NPC FRIENDSHIP EVENT: intimate academy common room at evening, warm fireplace, two adult student sprites seated across low table covered with handwritten notebooks (no legible letters), snacks teapot and levitating paper crane, purple player with silver hair and green-cloaked brown-haired roommate talking while sorting notes, two other students in background playing board game, abundant warm readable pixel props, leave bottom quiet for conversation UI.

screens.title: 단서 조사와 사건 선택
screens.focus: 기록 두 개의 차이와 조사 가능한 서가로 추리할 근거를 보여준다.
screens.scene: STORY INVESTIGATION: academy underground archive top down, moving bookshelves with brass rails, player shining a magical lantern at two side-by-side ghostly projections of the SAME courtyard but one intact fountain and one broken fountain, paper trails connect a damaged manuscript on pedestal to archive mechanism, librarian nearby, blue ghost light against warm bookshelf light, mystery inviting not horror, no words or letter-like scribbles.

screens.title: 별빛 장터와 학교 행사
screens.focus: 평소 교정이 행사 공간으로 바뀌고, 인물들이 새 조합으로 모인다.
screens.scene: SCHOOL FESTIVAL STARLIGHT FAIR: familiar stone academy courtyard at blue-hour night transformed with string lanterns, compact stalls showing magical teapots plants levitating crafts, small demonstration stage, students and town residents mingling, silver-haired purple player helping green-cloaked friend levitate a mechanical bird on stall, warm gold lanterns against deep blue sky-light, fountain center, joyful detailed pixel art no words.

screens.title: 동아리 공동 활동
screens.goal: 빛과 소리의 타이밍을 맞춰 짧은 장면을 완성하세요
screens.focus: 역할을 나눈 공동 실습과 친구의 반응이 동아리의 보상이다.
screens.scene: CLUB COLLABORATION ACTIVITY: small student theater rehearsal room top down, stage on top half with miniature illusory forest and paper moon, silver-haired purple player at a brass light console, one student adjusting sound crystals, another moving scenery and one performing, tiny light paths and colored spotlight circles make each role legible, seating cushions bottom, cozy handcrafted stage no audience crowds no text.

screens.title: 작은 부탁과 일상 문제
screens.focus: 일상 공간의 작은 문제를 배운 마법으로 바로 해결한다.
screens.scene: SMALL SCHOOL REQUEST QUEST: sunny quiet library entrance top down, a student librarian with broken small book trolley, five escaped magical books floating above cobblestone path, silver-haired purple player levitating one book toward trolley, dotted blue trail and highlighted landing square show the intended interaction; benches ivy pot plants students passing in background, everyday friendly problem no combat no text.

screens.title: 상가 교류와 재료 구매
screens.goal: 필요한 재료를 사고, 도구는 빌려 쓸 수 있어요
screens.focus: 재료·장식·대여의 선택을 한곳에서 보여준다. 필수 진행을 구매로 잠그지 않는다.
screens.scene: SHOP ECONOMY AND TOOL LOAN: top down tiny warm repair shop near magic academy, friendly adult shopkeeper behind curved wooden counter, material trays with herbs copper parts crystals, separate rack of clearly worn loan tools beside pristine decorative lamps for sale, purple silver player at counter, visible shelving and workbench with brass repair automaton, cozy original life sim pixel art, no price tags with text no menus.

screens.title: 학교 전체가 참여하는 최종 실습
screens.focus: 친구·교직원이 맡은 역할과 중앙 장치의 상태가 한눈에 보인다.
screens.scene: FINAL SCHOOL COOPERATIVE PRACTICAL: top down circular ancient magic academy chamber, central floating faceted crystal inside brass armillary sphere, three distinct floor energy channels of blue green amber leading to three stations, adult students and teachers each operate a station, silver-haired purple player at center adjusting small floating stones and protective ring, channels visibly becoming stable not explosive, climactic warm hopeful pixel art no horror no words.

screens.title: 수첩·힌트·다음 행동
screens.goal: 현재 가능한 행동과 대체 도구 경로를 확인하세요
screens.focus: 수첩을 열면 시간이 멈추고, 단서와 다음 행동을 필요한 만큼 확인한다.
screens.scene: JOURNAL AND PLANNING GAMEPLAY BACKDROP: top down cozy magic dorm desk close room view, purple silver player seated at desk with large open journal, map with SIX colored symbol pins no words on wall, calendar with geometric blank squares no letters, small lantern and quill, satchel, potted herb, morning window; leave CENTER RIGHT a large quiet dark wooden tabletop area for a web-added journal UI, crisp game-scale pixel props not illustration closeup.
